description: Attach a file to a task. Provide exactly one source: file_path (local), url (remote file to fetch), or base64 (raw content). file_name is required when using base64.

custom_task_ids.description: Set true when `task_id` is a custom task ID instead of a native ClickUp ID. Requires `team_id`.

file_name.description: File name (required for base64; overrides others).

team_id.description: Team/Workspace ID. Falls back to CLICKUP_TEAM_ID when omitted.

url.description: Remote HTTPS file URL to download and attach (private/loopback hosts are rejected).

name: upload_task_attachment
